text:
- United Kingdom generated £143,748.77 in revenue TW, representing 92.9% of total revenue across all entities and ranking first.
- United Kingdom revenue increased 10.1% WoW, rising from £130,586.63 in LW to £143,748.77 in TW.
- United Kingdom units sold grew from 76,814 in LW to 96,600 in TW, an increase of 19,786 units.
- Channel Islands revenue surged 334.5% WoW, climbing from £782.80 in LW to £3,401.24 in TW, with units rising from 146 to 1,673.
- France revenue increased 349.8% WoW, jumping from £282.60 in LW to £1,271.21 in TW with 763 units sold.
- Switzerland revenue declined 82.0% WoW, falling from £7,802.09 in LW to £1,407.70 in TW, with units dropping from 5,011 to 787.
- EIRE revenue decreased 28.4% WoW, declining from £2,637.72 in LW to £1,889.68 in TW despite units remaining relatively stable at 1,013.
- Germany revenue fell 62.5% WoW, dropping from £2,953.98 in LW to £1,107.38 in TW with units declining from 1,415 to 904.
